version.changelog: L7b quality fix - VAGUE_TASK cleared, input/output sections added

llm.summary: This PDF helper skill is a simple Markdown instruction set whose file and command access matches its stated PDF processing purpose.

dimensions.detail: Local Python, pypdf, optional reportlab, and filesystem access are proportionate for PDF processing; no hidden network data flow or credential use is instructed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There are no executable artifact files or install hooks; the instructions mention pip installs for dependencies, including an arguably unnecessary requests package, but installation remains user-directed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives broad natural-language PDF workflows and example Python operations rather than tightly enumerated allowed commands, so users should keep commands scoped to chosen PDF files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, credential/session access, or automatic long-running behavior is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is reading, creating, extracting text from, and doing basic page operations on PDFs; read, write, and exec capabilities are coherent with local PDF input/output and Python library usage.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the agent read and write the PDFs you name and run local Python/PDF commands. Review any generated shell or pip command before execution, and keep outputs in a controlled working folder.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The artifact declares write and exec access, and those are expected for creating or editing PDFs with local Python tooling. The disclosure could be more prominent and confirmation-focused, but the behavior is purpose-aligned and not hidden.
